accepted.name: subject_offered_latest_by_section
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
  COMPOSITE_SUBJECT_KEY,
  TERM_CODE,
  MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER,
  MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER_SORT,
  MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER_DESC,
  MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
  MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
  COURSE_NUMBER,
  COURSE_NUMBER_SORT,
  COURSE_NUMBER_DESC,
  SUBJECT_ID,
  SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
  SUBJECT_TITLE,
  SECTION_ID,
  IS_MASTER_SECTION,
  IS_LECTURE_SECTION,
  IS_LAB_SECTION,
  IS_RECITATION_SECTION,
  IS_DESIGN_SECTION,
  OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
  OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME,
  RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
  RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
  MEET_TIME,
  MEET_PLACE,
  CLUSTER_TYPE,
  CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC,
  CLUSTER_LIST,
  HGN_CODE,
  HGN_CODE_DESC,
  FORM_TYPE,
  FORM_TYPE_DESC,
  SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
  SECTION_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
  CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,
  EVALUATE_THIS_SUBJECT,
  IS_OSE_SUBJECT,
  IS_CREATED_BY_DATA_WAREHOUSE,
  SUBJECT_GROUPING_KEY,
  WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,
  NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
  SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY,
  IS_REPEATABLE_SUBJECT,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY SECTION_ID
    ORDER BY COALESCE(WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, '') DESC, SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY DESC
  ) AS section_row_rank
FROM subject_offered

semantic_filters.none: no fixed filter; consumer can filter where section_row_rank = 1 to get latest per SECTION_ID

accepted.description: For each SECTION_ID in subject_offered, pick the latest SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY row by WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE. Useful when downstream queries need one canonical/latest record per section (top-K by recency). | Use for: Get latest section offerings and their enrollment counts; De-duplicate multiple records per section by latest WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE; Join latest section row to faculty or room tables

accepted.name: subject_summary_enrollment_agg_by_term_subject
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  TERM_CODE,
  SUBJECT_ID,
  SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
  SUBJECT_TITLE,
  MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
  MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
  DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  SCHOOL_CODE,
  SCHOOL_NAME,
  SUM(COALESCE(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, 0)) AS total_subject_enrollment_number,
  SUM(COALESCE(CLUSTER_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, 0)) AS total_cluster_enrollment_number,
  SUM(COALESCE(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_CREDIT, 0)) AS total_subject_enrollment_credit,
  SUM(COALESCE(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_LISTEN, 0)) AS total_subject_enrollment_listen,
  SUM(COALESCE(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_FIRST_WEEK, 0)) AS total_subject_enrollment_first_week,
  SUM(COALESCE(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_FIFTH_WEEK, 0)) AS total_subject_enrollment_fifth_week,
  MAX(WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS last_warehouse_load_date
FROM subject_summary
GROUP BY
  TERM_CODE,
  SUBJECT_ID,
  SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
  SUBJECT_TITLE,
  MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
  MASTER_SUBJECT_ID_SORT,
  DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  SCHOOL_CODE,
  SCHOOL_NAME

semantic_filters.none: no fixed filter; consumers can restrict by TERM_CODE or SCHOOL_CODE

accepted.description: Aggregates enrollment and unit measures from subject_summary by TERM_CODE and SUBJECT_ID. One row per combination of TERM_CODE and SUBJECT_ID with common measures exposed for reporting trend and joins. | Use for: Term-by-term enrollment trends for a subject; Compare first-week vs fifth-week enrollment by subject; Join aggregated subject enrollment to department or faculty tables

accepted.name: fac_rooms_space_area
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY,
  fr.BUILDING_KEY,
  fb.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
  fb.BUILDING_NUMBER AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
  fr.FLOOR AS FLOOR,
  ff.FLOOR_KEY AS FLOOR_KEY,
  fr.ROOM,
  fr.SPACE_ID,
  fr.MAJOR_USE_KEY,
  fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC,
  fr.USE_KEY,
  fr.USE_DESC,
  fr.MINOR_USE_KEY,
  fr.MINOR_USE_DESC,
  fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY,
  fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  fr.MINOR_ORGANIZATION_KEY,
  fr.MINOR_ORGANIZATION,
  fr.AREA,
  fr.ROOM_FULL_NAME,
  fr.DEPT_CODE,
  fr.ACCESS_LEVEL,
  fr.LATITUDE_WGS,
  fr.LONGITUDE_WGS,
  fr.NORTHING_SPCS,
  fr.EASTING_SPCS,
  fr.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
FROM fac_rooms fr
LEFT JOIN fac_building fb
  ON fr.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN fac_floor ff
  ON fr.FLOOR_KEY = ff.FLOOR_KEY

semantic_filters.none: no fixed filter; consumers can filter by AREA or ORGANIZATION_KEY

accepted.description: Denormalized room-level space data joining fac_rooms to fac_building and fac_floor where available. One row per FAC_ROOM_KEY with building and floor attributes to support spatial reporting and allocations. | Use for: Room area by department/building for space utilization; Map rooms with coordinates; Aggregate area by building or organization

accepted.name: employee_directory_contact_normalized
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  MIT_ID,
  LAST_NAME,
  FIRST_NAME,
  MIDDLE_NAME,
  FULL_NAME,
  DIRECTORY_FULL_NAME,
  OFFICE_LOCATION,
  OFFICE_PHONE,
  DIRECTORY_TITLE,
  PRIMARY_TITLE,
  DEPARTMENT_NUMBER,
  DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  KRB_NAME,
  KRB_NAME_UPPERCASE,
  EMAIL_ADDRESS,
  PERSONAL_URL,
  NAME_KNOWN_BY,
  EMAIL_ADDRESS_UPPERCASE,
  FULL_NAME_UPPERCASE,
  COALESCE(PREFERRED_FIRST_NAME, FIRST_NAME) AS PREFERRED_FIRST_NAME,
  COALESCE(PREFERRED_LAST_NAME, LAST_NAME) AS PREFERRED_LAST_NAME,
  COALESCE(PREFERRED_MIDDLE_NAME, MIDDLE_NAME) AS PREFERRED_MIDDLE_NAME
FROM employee_directory

semantic_filters.none: no fixed filter; consumers may restrict to IS_ACTIVE variants in other tables

accepted.description: Cleans and projects core contact and identity fields from employee_directory. Useful as a canonical employee lookup for joins to course, space or HR data. | Use for: Lookup contact info for a given MIT_ID or KRB_NAME; Join employee contact info to faculty or course assignments; List email directories for a department

accepted.name: time_month_fiscal_anchor
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  TIME_MONTH_KEY,
  FISCAL_PERIOD,
  FISCAL_PERIOD_DESCRIPTION,
  FISCAL_YEAR,
  FY_QUARTER_CODE,
  CALENDAR_PERIOD,
  CALENDAR_PERIOD_DESCRIPTION,
  CALENDAR_YEAR,
  START_DATE,
  END_DATE,
  CALENDAR_MONTH,
  CALENDAR_MONTH_NAME,
  IS_CURRENT_FISCAL_PERIOD,
  IS_PREVIOUS_FISCAL_PERIOD,
  ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  ACADEMIC_TERM,
  ACADEMIC_TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR,
  FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR_DESC
FROM time_month

semantic_filters.none: no fixed filter; consumers can filter by IS_CURRENT_FISCAL_PERIOD or FISCAL_YEAR

accepted.description: Canonical fiscal month dimension rows with keys used for time-based joins and filtering. One row per TIME_MONTH_KEY/FISCAL_PERIOD representing a fiscal month. Useful for aligning financial facts to fiscal months. | Use for: Join financial transactions to fiscal months; Filter facts to current or previous fiscal period; Aggregate metrics by fiscal year/quarter/month
